display.purpose: The hero h1 only; a two-line lockup, second line in the stage accent; 5.25rem at 1600px and up; never animates on load.

headline.purpose: Section titles on the stage and the light page.

lede.purpose: Hero lede (40ch); section intros use clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.25vw, 1.1875rem) at 46ch.

body.purpose: Running text; row and node text at 1.55 and 34-38ch.

label.purpose: Navigation links and button labels (buttons at 550).

index.purpose: Spine rail numbers, tabular; 600 for the current section.

shadows.name: glass-sheen
shadows.purpose: Glass button top edge on the stage.

shadows.name: node-glow
shadows.purpose: A lit service icon in 02, with a 1px rgb(127 176 247 / 0.55) ring.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Inherited Deal Desk card depth for light-page surfaces.

shadows.name: stage-glow
shadows.purpose: The light behind the orb on the stage field.

shadows.name: header-frost
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%) on light; rgb(15 30 58 / 0.74) with blur(16px) saturate(160%) over the stage
shadows.purpose: Fixed header once content scrolls under it; solid under reduced transparency.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals and state changes; the orb's zoom and opacity.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen travel; the orb's position between keyframes.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Things that travel in from an edge (inherited).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: linear() spring, 0.2s, bounce 0.14; falls back to ease-out.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: linear() landing, 0.34s, bounce 0.2; falls back to ease-out.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: linear() release, 0.26s, bounce 0.32; falls back to ease-out.

motion.name: dur-quick
motion.purpose: Hover, colour, rail and skip-link transitions.

motion.name: orb-spring
motion.value: critically damped, stiffness 130, damping 23 (~0.35s, no overshoot)
motion.purpose: Carries the orb's position, zoom and opacity between K0-K3 in pixel space.

motion.name: orb-keyframes
motion.value: K0 hero column (zoom 1, opacity 1); K1 01 spine (opacity 0.9, drifts up); K2 02 dock (pinned); K3 dock at 0.86 zoom, then fade out

motion.name: orb-in
motion.purpose: Canvas fade-in; removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: travel-query
motion.purpose: The only condition under which the orb travels and 02 pins; CSS decides, JS reads.

motion.name: reveal-rows
motion.value: rise-in (12px, fade) on view(), entry 0% to cover 28%; rule-draw entry 40% to cover 42%

motion.name: reveal-hub
motion.value: --hub view timeline on a 200svh track; nodes light in 8% slices from contain 8% to 66%, 10% apart; close rises contain 70% to 84%

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no orb fade, travel, pin, reveals or header/rail/skip-link transitions; all content in final state

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark instrument room lit from one source. A deep navy field holds a single luminous point cloud, the ink orb, which stands for Bgentic's system and is carried through the opening of the page: it sits in the hero, takes the spine between each problem and its fix, then docks as the hub of the six services. Everything else on the stage is quiet so the light has somewhere to fall: white display type set tight, pale sky body copy, 1px hairlines, a faint technical grid that fades out from the orb.

Below the stage the world turns to daylight: the Deal Desk's cool grey ground, ink type, white surfaces. The two halves share one token sheet, one type family and one button language, so the switch reads as stepping out of the observatory, not into another site. Depth comes from light and blending (a `screen`-blended canvas, a radial glow, an accent halo under the one filled action), never from neon or saturated colour. The palette is pinned by the brand: light blue, dark navy, slate and white. Do not invent colours.

Density is low and rhythmic: one idea per viewport on the stage, generous fluid padding, measures held to 34–46ch.
keyCharacteristics: One navy stage for sections 00–02, then the light page.
One luminous object (the ink orb) as the only illustration.
Inter Variable at every size, optical sizing on, display weights at 640 with negative tracking.
Pill buttons; exactly one filled accent action per view.
Motion is native scroll, sticky pins, CSS scroll timelines and one critically damped spring. No animation library.
Light and dark themes switch by token, not by second stylesheet.

rules.name: The Stage Composition Rule
rules.body: The stage's own variables (`--st-top`, `--st-base`, `--st-ink`, `--st-body`, `--st-quiet`, `--st-accent-text`, `--st-rule`, `--st-grid`, `--st-glow`, `--st-danger`, `--st-success`) are compositions of existing token hexes and alphas, re-pointed per theme. A new stage surface reads from these, never from new hexes.

rules.name: The Verbatim Sheet Rule
rules.body: `src/styles/tokens.css` is the Deal Desk's sheet, ported verbatim. Re-sync it from the source; never edit a value in place. Site-only additions (the pressed step) live in `globals.css`.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Display and headline sit at 640, titles at 600, actions at 550, labels at 500. Contrast between levels comes from these steps and tightening tracking (-0.006em body to -0.035em display), never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Balanced Lines Rule
rules.body: Headings use balanced wrapping and paragraphs pretty wrapping; measures stay between 34ch and 46ch.

rules.name: The Brief-Pinned Grid Rule
rules.body: The 64px technical grid behind the hero belongs to the stage, pinned by the brief: 1px lines at 7% sky-400, masked by a radial fade centred on the orb (centred under the copy below 1024px). It is not a general background texture for other sections.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: On the stage, glow belongs to the orb, the primary action and lit service icons. Nothing else emits light.

dos: Do keep exactly one filled accent-blue action per view; its partner is glass on the stage or outline on light.
Do compose stage colour from the `--st-*` roles, which re-point per theme from existing token hexes.
Do verify every text pair at WCAG 2.2 AA: white on accent-blue 4.6:1, sky-200 on navy 12:1, sky-400 on navy 7.5:1, slate on ground 5.0:1.
Do gate any travelling or pinned motion on `(min-width: 1024px) and (hover: hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, in CSS first.
Do use native scroll, sticky pins, CSS scroll timelines and the one critically damped spring for motion.
Do use the spine rail's numbers as the page's section index; that is where numbering lives.
Do keep danger and success to small marks and fading 1px rules beside text.
donts: Don't add an animation library; the orb controller is plain DOM and the reveals are CSS.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels over headings, numbered or otherwise; the numbered spine is a navigation rail, not a heading ornament.
Don't reuse the technical grid outside the hero stage; it is pinned by the brief to the orb.
Don't invent colours outside the token sheet, or edit `tokens.css` values in place.
Don't animate the h1 on load, or let anything that starts on its own move for more than 5 seconds.
Don't set display type in a second face; Inter Variable carries every level.
